items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 154:1
items.html: (To the question) The three ways that apply to the joining of AVI and YESHSUT into one Partzuf, as above in Answer 283, which indicate three distinct discernments that were made due to the joining — they also apply to the joining of the great ZON with the small ZON into one Partzuf, and in them too there are those same three indications. In the first way it is discerned that ZA and Yaakov are made one Partzuf, and Leah and Rachel are made one. And this indicates that the male is entirely MA: MA of MA and MA of BON. And the female is entirely BON: BON of MA and BON of BON. And the second way is that the great ZON are both made into ZA alone, and the small ZON grow to an equal stature with ZA, and they are both made into the aspect of Nukva alone — namely, like the second way of AVI. And this indicates that ZA remains, after the Nesira, entirely Hesed, namely in the aspect of covered Hassadim, like the upper AVI, who are the aspect of the closed Mem of Tzelem and covered Hassadim, as above in Part 13. And the Nukva becomes entirely revealed Hassadim, like the aspect of the small ZON, which resemble YESHSUT. And the third way is that Rachel grows and ascends above and takes the place of Leah, and Leah becomes her internality. And this indicates that the coupling is made in the aspect of Rachel, who needs the illumination of Hochma, like Tevuna — and not in the aspect of Leah, who does not need the illumination of Hochma, like Bina, which does not need the illumination of Hochma, as is known. Therefore Leah is hidden and becomes the internality of Rachel. And this resembles the third way of AVI mentioned above. (p. 792, Sub Header “And likewise”).
